summary: Join our Microfinance and Social Protection Training to gain essential skills for fostering economic growth and improving social welfare in your community.
lede: Social protection and microfinance programmes connect household vulnerability assessment with responsible service delivery. For microfinance managers, social protection officers and financial inclusion specialists, this training supports coordinated services while helping reduce avoidable debt and exclusion. Learn to assess targeting and eligibility, review client-protection controls, map cash-transfer delivery and grievance processes, and define indicators for monitoring outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course suits experienced professionals who connect financial inclusion, household resilience, social assistance, and responsible programme operations. It is designed for professionals who already work with programme data, client records, field operations, policy implementation, or performance reporting and need a stronger integrated approach to microfinance and social protection.
prerequisites: Prior experience in microfinance, social protection, financial inclusion, cash transfer operations, programme monitoring, public policy, or related programme administration is recommended. You should be comfortable reading basic programme data and operational reports. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted eligibility analysis and digital data governance are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not software engineering or production implementation levels.
